In December 2021, the most of us gathered around one bill. Fourteen of us said "and jobs act" on 2021-12-17; thirteen said "infrastructure investment and jobs act" the same day, twelve "the infrastructure investment and jobs act." On that one date our language converged. Ten of us reached for "the bipartisan infrastructure investment," nine for "the bipartisan infrastructure investment and jobs." We did not originate all of it; the record marks Lisa Murkowski first saying the longer forms on 2021-08-02, Todd Young first with "the bipartisan infrastructure investment" on 2021-08-08.

Earlier that month we spoke of process. Twelve of us said "the national defense authorization act" on 2021-12-07, eleven "national defense authorization act ndaa" the next day. Ten of us said "the protecting our democracy act" on 2021-12-09. We report only what we repeated, and how many of us repeated it.

the bipartisan infrastructure investment and jobs
